A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same UPDESH study with 28 readable pages, including Appendices A–C. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the scientific content matches; differences are confined to version identification and PDF title metadata.

before.justification: v2 reports original human/LLM data-quality assessments, Llama and Phi-4 fine-tuning experiments, ablations, and cultural evaluations in Sections 4–5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the ablation and cultural-comparison results in Tables 3–5 and detailed quality and benchmark results in Tables 10–15.

M1.justification: The translated reasoning subset, Wikipedia-grounded generative pipeline, teacher models, and filtering rules remain identical in Section 3 and the appendices.

E1.justification: Both retain the same training languages, NLU/NLG benchmarks, evaluation on 16 unseen languages, and cultural-query domains (Sections 3 and 5; Appendices B.8 and C).

E2.justification: The base-model, BACTRIAN-X, INDICALIGN, and AYA-COLLECTION benchmark comparators are unchanged in Tables 11–15. Table 5 also retains the same seven cultural-comparison entries.

E3.justification: Model configurations, baseline subsampling, evaluation metrics, annotation sampling, training settings, and cultural pairwise-comparison procedures are identical (Sections 4–5; Table 9; Appendix C).

E4.justification: The dataset-composition and sequence-length ablations, unseen-language tests, evaluator-agreement analyses, and ELO/benchmark correlations are unchanged, including their appendix evidence.

E5.justification: Percentage-agreement and rating-distribution reporting remains identical in Section 4.2 and Appendix B.4. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-reporting information changes.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative findings match, including the appendix breakdowns. For example, Table 12 retains UPDESH NLG averages of 36.41 for Llama 8B and 36.56 for Phi-4.

T1.justification: The assumptions and mathematical content are unchanged. Neither version contains formal theoretical results or proofs that are added, removed, or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about the 9.5M-example dataset, culturally grounded synthesis, downstream performance, and limitations of LLM judges.

C2.justification: Interpretations of subset contributions, cross-lingual transfer, and evaluator agreement are identical. Section 7 retains the same limitations concerning Wikipedia coverage, evaluator reliability, and specialized benchmarking.

D1.justification: The reproducibility statement, code/data release statements, generation and training hyperparameters, and evaluation prompts are unchanged (Appendices A, B.5–B.6, and C.1).

R1.justification: Section 2, the reference list, and research-positioning discussions in Appendix B.1 are identical. No cited works or relationships to prior research change.

P1.justification: The arXiv margin stamp changes from v2 dated 9 Jan 2026 to v3 dated 26 Feb 2026, and the PDF title metadata adds the omitted word 'Languages'. The visible title, manuscript wording, and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: All 13 figures and 15 tables retain identical displays, captions, labels, and placement. Rendered pages match exactly outside the first-page version/date stamp; page layout is unchanged.

improvement.justification: The main text and appendices retain identical methods, evidence, interpretations, limitations, and substantive presentation. Updating the version/date stamp and completing the PDF title metadata produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
